builds.name: Peerless Desperado
builds.desc:
For those of us who are not graced with twenty extra Hector's in our barracks to burn for Distant Counter, I offer a well rounded use of Linus. He'll act very similarly to Raven, but can be utilized in any mode without requiring Life and Death 3 as a skill and as the Basilikos refinement.
Basilikos is given to him naturally at 5-stars so it's an easy choice. It also reduces skill Cooldown, guaranteeing a special proc during any battle if you use anything under 3CD.
Luna is reduced to a 2CD thanks to Basilikos, comes naturally, and is powerful, so yeah... Use it. If you'd rather increase your survivability, just swap Luna with Sol to get some life back after each fight.
Brazen Atk/Spd 3 is another skill Linus already comes with, and frequently can change the tide of a fight. On top of adding plenty of Atk it increases his chances of doubling, a true win-win. This synergizes well with his next skill.
Desperation 3 plays an excellent role in combination with his specials and his A-skill. His Def isn't amazing, so after one hit will most likely be in both Brazen Atk/Spd 3 and Desperation 3 range. And thanks to Basilikos after one attack and one retaliation during the enemy phase, Luna will be ready to go, with an extra hit for good measure right afterwards during player phase. If you'd rather hit first, simply use Vantage 3 and you'll retaliate with a
Luna during the enemy phase.
Spd Smoke 3 will ensure anyone else who comes at you after the first round will be significantly slower, padding your chances to double. Use Atk Smoke 3 if you'd rather pad your defense.
Quick Riposte 3 Helps guarantee you get doubles, and doubles with this character means Luna activations. Quickened Pulse also pads this activation chance if you haven't invested in the other seal.
Overall Linus will be an excellent choice to fulfill that often-missing green slot in your team. This is all contingent on Linus becoming a boss in GHB, of course, so let's all cross our fingers.
(Update) Already tested in Arena and Squad Assault... Linus is a player phase monster. One hit brings him into Desperation 3 range, and bumps his Atk/Spd to 60/40 thanks to Brazen Atk/Spd 3. One hit and Luna activates, guaranteeing whomever he cut in half the first hit doesn't stand back up. And with his respectable 32 Def he'll survive the next enemy phase as long as you keep him away from magic.

builds.name: Ravenous Dog
builds.desc:
With his amazing weapon, Basilikos, and his impressive stat spread, Linus can offer outstanding performance in battle with the addition of two skills to his kit.
The only skills that need to be inherited in this build are Moonbow and Desperation 3. Due to his Brazen skill activating at near the same threshold as Desperation, the two skills offer great synergy to ensure +7 atk/spd and no counters if the Mad Dog kills the enemy with his two attacks. Due to this, he cannot charge his original special, Luna, quickly enough to use it every fight, but thanks to Basilikos's cooldown reducing effect, he can activate Moonbow or Glimmer in every combat, due to them being charged and ready to use after just one hit. This runs under the assumption that he always doubles his enemies, which requires speed stacking, something the Life and Death 3 refine helps him achieve. The choice of Speed +3 seal only exists to help him further, both before and after he activates Brazen Atk/Spd 3. After he does, and with a Hone Spd 3 buff, he can go as far as to double most of the fastest units in the game, including most Ayra builds, guaranteeing ORKOs on them.
Despite being very cheap and powerful, this build requires him to enter Desperation range in every fight, which might prove difficult sometimes. However, his 27 base def after the Basilikos refine helps him here, having sufficient bulk to tank a physical hit from almost anyone and survive it. Regardless, he gets hard-countered by weapons or skills that prevent him from doubling, or reduce his damage if he doubles. Such skills are, for example, Great Flame/ Urvan/ Wary Fighter 3/ Axebreaker 3/ Deflect Melee 3.

builds.name: Relentless Desperado
builds.desc:
The one catch with this build is that it relies more heavily on getting Linus into that sweet spot of health to activate both Brazen Atk/Spd 3 and Desperation 3. Once he's there, he will be able to attack twice and kill nearly any unit before they can retaliate, even without the use of a damage boosting Special.
This frees him up to some of the most horrifying exploitation of Galeforce possible in the game. Combining the natural cool-down reduction of Basilikos with the nearly constant boost from Heavy Blade 3 means that he can get a second action -- and likely a second kill -- EVERY turn. Combine with the aid of a Refresher unit for maximum potential. Odd Atk Wave 3 just makes this outcome all the more common.
Pivot is chosen for the Assist with this build to give Linus an escape option without needing to expend another unit's action just to get him out of danger. Linus is very vulnerable during the enemy phase with this build, so giving him the option to employ hit-and-run tactics instead of needing a buddy to bail him out makes him just that much more flexible.
